dish_name: fried rice with meat, broccoli and bok choy
components: fried rice with meat and vegetables
source: generic recipe written by claude-opus-5-5 from the dish name only; not taken from any recording

ingredients.name: chicken thigh, pork or char siu

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Fetch the cooked rice, meat, broccoli, bok choy, eggs and spring onions from the fridge
steps.checkpoint: fridge items are on the counter

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Fetch the garlic, sauces, cornstarch, oil and seasoning from the pantry
steps.checkpoint: pantry items are on the counter

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Get out the wok, spatula, cutting board, knife and small bowls

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Cut the meat into small pieces and toss with a little soy sauce and cornstarch

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Cut the broccoli into small florets

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Wash the bok choy and chop stems and leaves

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Mince the garlic and slice the spring onions
steps.checkpoint: garlic minced and spring onions sliced

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Beat the eggs in a bowl

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Break up any clumps in the cold rice

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Scramble the eggs in hot oil in the wok and remove
steps.checkpoint: eggs are softly scrambled and set aside

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the meat until cooked and remove
steps.checkpoint: meat is cooked and set aside

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the garlic, broccoli and bok choy stems with a splash of water until nearly tender
steps.checkpoint: broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Add the rice and stir-fry on high heat until hot and slightly toasted

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Return the egg and meat, add bok choy leaves, soy sauce, oyster sauce, white pepper and salt
steps.checkpoint: everything is tossed together and seasoned

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Finish with spring onions and sesame oil

steps.component: fried rice with meat and vegetables
steps.text: Serve the fried rice in bowls
